name: Ricardo Velez
bio:
Ricardo's journey into motorsport began in Bogota, tinkering with go-karts as a teenager. He quickly realized his passion lay not in driving, but in understanding the intricate mechanics that made them tick. He pursued a degree in mechanical engineering, specializing in aerodynamics. After graduating, Ricardo honed his skills in various racing series across South America, eventually attracting the attention of Hitech GP. 

Known for his meticulous approach and data-driven decision-making, Ricardo believes a strong technical team thrives on clear communication and a shared understanding of the car's performance. He emphasizes innovation and is always pushing his team to explore new solutions, but never at the expense of reliability. His ability to balance cutting-edge ideas with practical execution makes him a valuable asset to Hitech GP.

Ricardo distinguishes himself with an uncanny ability to diagnose mechanical problems simply by listening to the engine. He fosters a collaborative environment where team members feel empowered to contribute their expertise, firmly believing that the best solutions arise from collective intelligence.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight receding hairline.
physical.description: Ricardo is of average height with a lean build, often seen with a focused expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen, jotting down ideas and observations.
Has a peculiar habit of tapping his fingers on his desk when deep in thought.
Insists on listening to salsa music during lunch breaks.
